rules.base: Live career card; recalculates whenever event data changes.
rules.leader: One permanent card per category per player, dated the first time the lead was claimed.
rules.hall: Permanent when first earned at the historical Hall qualification threshold.
rules.heater: One permanent card that upgrades whenever the player sets a longer personal cash streak.
rules.snapshot: Event stats, tier and all six attributes are frozen at issuance or upgrade; OVR uses those frozen stats on the current fixed card scale.

rules.activeSkin: Uses the first card in the permanent prestige-ordered collection, or Base when no special edition is earned.
rules.liveData: The automatic skin changes presentation only; ratings, tier placement, Crew ordering and ownership remain unchanged.
